result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one significant layout problem where content is obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, and one minor truncation issue in a restaurant title.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the feed content, causing the next restaurant card to be partially hidden behind it.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so list items stay fully visible above the navigation bar.

issues.description: Some restaurant names are truncated with ellipses, such as the partially visible 'Trattoria Picco...'.
issues.suggestion: Widen the card text area if possible or use a shorter secondary line so key names remain readable.
